Name: `nomodeset`
Description: Set to completely disable graphics driver loading
Notes:
Check [linux kernel's parameter](https://www.kernel.org/doc/html/next/admin-guide/kernel-parameters.html), search for `nomodeset` for more info.
This option is useful in case your graphics driver causes black screen or artifacts on BlissOS.

Name: `HWACCEL`
Description: Completely disable hardware acceleration. Unset to re-enable.
Notes: Different from `nomodeset`, graphics driver is still being loaded, it just that Gralloc & HWC setup is now set the same as `nomodeset`. This is useful in case that graphics driver can load fine but it can't get into BlissOS.

Name: `EGL`
Description: Switching between different implementation of libEGL

Name: `MESA_LLVMPIPE`
Description: Force Mesa EGL to use llvmpipe. Unset to use default.

Name: `MESA_ZINK`
Description: Force Mesa EGL to use Zink. Unset to use default.

Name: `FORCE_GLES`
Description: Set OpenGLES version. Unset to use default.

Name: `FORCE_RENDERENGINE`
Description: Force RenderEngine backend to skiagl. Unset to use default.
Notes:
Check [SurfaceFlinger.cpp](https://cs.android.com/android/platform/superproject/+/android-latest-release:frameworks/native/services/surfaceflinger/SurfaceFlinger.cpp), search for `PROPERTY_DEBUG_RENDERENGINE_BACKEND` to know about the available backend.
`threaded` used to be the default option until BlissOS 16. Starting from BlissOS 17 we have to set `skiaglthreaded` because `threaded` is being deprecated.

Name: `HWC_HIDL`
Description: Set HWC HIDL interface. Unset to use default.

Name: `HWC`
Description: Set HWC interface. Unset to use default.
Notes: `HWC` should be set to `drm_minigbm` or `drm_minigbm_celadon` only when using `minigbm*` gralloc.

Name: `GRALLOC`
Description: Set default gralloc. Unset to use default.
Notes: `minigbm_arcvm` is only for VMs using `virtio-gpu` driver.

Name: `GRALLOC4_MINIGBM`
Description: Uses Gralloc4 service instead of legacy Gralloc HAL on `minigbm`
Notes: Only usable if you use any `minigbm*` gralloc.

Name: `VULKAN`
Description: Set Vulkan HAL. Unset to use default.

Name: `vmwgfx.force_resolution`
Description: Force resolution on `vmwgfx` driver. Unset to use default.
Notes: Extra parameter for `vmwgfx` driver taken from [0xCAFEBABE commit](https://github.com/android-generic/kernel-zenith/commit/f006384703f4412bd478fdc143e47385d7c425a2)

Name: `virtio-gpu.force_resolution`
Description: Force resolution on `virtio-gpu` driver. Unset to use default.
Notes: Extra parameter for `virtio-gpu` driver taken from [0xCAFEBABE commit](https://github.com/android-generic/kernel-zenith/commit/dc271fee1ced8cba3507058774b3e5242c1ccff0)

Name: `nouveau.modeset`
Description: Disable `nouveau` driver for Nvidia GPUs. Unset to re-enable.
Notes: Useful for laptops with Nvidia GPUs because in most cases we will not touch it.
